purpose: Requirements for the consult skill: dialogue facilitation that conveys topics clearly to users, presents briefs with recommendations and confidence, tracks progress, and obtains user decisions.
summary: Overview of consult responsibilities and three uses: review, dialogue-based revision, new creation
Glossary: evaluation, consult topic, consult brief, presentation state
Scope and exclusions, including no execution of undecided matters
FNC-001/002: topic intake, verification, and progress list management with user-led decisions
FNC-003/006: two-column consult brief (summary and recommendation), concise, no inferior options
FNC-004/005: confidence markers and restating context
FNC-007 to 010: Q&A, decision capture, suspension, deferral, user owns settlement
FNC-012 to 014: brief authored by main Claude, built before speaking, recorded via script
BL-001/002 and NFR-001 to 005: no unauthorized execution, fidelity, state placement, secrets, failure visibility
tasks: Designing or implementing the consult skill
Reviewing consult requirements or design documents
Writing consult SKILL procedures per use case
Designing the HTML presentation script for dialogue use
title: REQ-017 consult 対話進行スキル要件定義書
